start.how_it_works: ℹ️ How it works 1️⃣ Set your price. You decide what it costs to message you — in sum, dollars or stars. 2️⃣ Share your link. Anyone who wants to reach you goes through it. 3️⃣ They pay, you earn. The money lands in your balance automatically. 4️⃣ Withdraw. Card, Payme, Click or USDT. 💡 Free for Telegram Premium users, exceptions for friends, a different price at night — all configurable.

help.title: ℹ️ Help
help.text: ℹ️ PulBot help Main commands /start — main menu /balans — wallet /narx — quickly change your price /havola — your link /yechish — withdraw /til — change language /yordam — this page In a group /sozlash — group settings (admins) /narx 5000 — set the price /bepul @user — add an exception /bloklash @user — block someone Questions 💬 Support: {support}
help.faq: ❓ Frequently asked questions Where does the money come from? The person messaging you pays with Telegram Stars, which they buy however they like — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay. What's the commission? The platform takes {commission}% of each payment. The rest is yours. How do I withdraw? Wallet → Withdraw. Pick card, Payme, Click or USDT. Requests are handled within 24 hours. What is escrow? When a paid message arrives, the money is credited after you reply, not before. It's a guarantee for the sender — no reply, money back. How does it work in groups? Add the bot as an admin and set a price. Whoever writes is charged, and the money goes to you. Admins, Premium users or people you pick can write for free.
